verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies a self-managed edition: it refers to 'Bitbucket Server or Data Center' and to a 'Bitbucket Data Center license', but always as the source for migrating to Bitbucket Cloud. Nothing documents installing, configuring, upgrading, or maintaining an instance on your own infrastructure, and the messaging steers users toward Cloud. Private CI runners are an adjacent feature, not self-hosting the instance, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of installing a self-hosted instance, configuration and administration guidance, upgrade procedures, maintenance and operations docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted operation.
